source_reasoning.candidate_design: Use insertion-ordered maps, moving accessed keys to the newest position and evicting the oldest entry until within capacity.
source_reasoning.complexity_target: O(1) expected get/put; resize proportional to evictions
source_reasoning.reference: Linear ordered list of key/value pairs with explicit scans.
source_reasoning.limits: Only bounded author-development cases are executed; full official domain/resource suitability is unknown

numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.
unicode_semantics: Passwords use Unicode code points; board and remaining identifier/string domains follow the explicit ASCII/lowercase contracts.

assumptions.basis: Public group preview only; no exact variant body

assumptions.text: Provide get, put and resize with least-recently-used eviction. get returns -1 for absence and otherwise refreshes recency. put refreshes existing keys. Nonnegative resize immediately evicts oldest entries until within capacity; zero capacity retains nothing.

snapshot_cost: Map recency operations are O(1); cloning a non-scalar stored value costs O(value size).
